messages:
maria: Quick PR question — I'm updating the audit-export docs to clarify how consent signals affect exports. Draft snippet below, PTAL:

maria: ```json
{
  "export_scope": "tenant",
  "redaction": "partial",
  "consent_signal": "customer_admin"
}
```

jamal: thanks — can we avoid the phrase 'customer consent' without qualifier? it reads ambiguous. prefer 'customer_admin consent' or link to the consent matrix. also where will the SDK examples live?

devon: pushed a tiny change to the python snippet path to use our snippets dir. commit: https://git.re/redwood/docs/commit/abc123 — it still uses export_scope in the example.

olivia: Legal note: please do NOT use wording like 'we anonymize' in public docs. use 'pseudonymize' or 'redact' and call out that some exports are subject to legal holds. also they'd like the TTL example to avoid hard-coded retention durations in prose.

docs-bot: PR #482 opened: https://git.re/redwood/docs/pull/482 — CI passed on the docs build.

maria: okay updated wording per legal and moved the snippet into sdk-examples. added an edge-case note for DSARs and archival copies. new snippet: ```json
{
  "export_scope": "tenant",
  "redaction": "partial",
  "retention_days": 365
}
```

jamal: :thumbsup: looks fine. one more ask — add a short migration note for SDK v2: the param name changes from `export_scope` -> `scope`. that helps customers search.

devon: i'll add the migration snippet and bump the example to v2. also will replace the literal link to retention policy with a relative docs link.

olivia: Approved from Legal on phrasing. please replace 'delete immediately' language with 'subject to retention policy and legal exceptions' (important).

maria: thanks all — final push incoming. deploy-bot: docs deploy queued for production. :rocket:

deploy-bot: docs site deploy started: https://deploys.redwood/infrastructure/9876

maria: closing thread once deploy completes, will follow up if legal asks for more tweaks.
